2607.21274.title: A Comparative Evaluation of Embeddings and LLMs in a Greek Book Publisher Setting - The CUP Dataset
2607.21274.paper_summary: We present CUP, a Greek book retrieval benchmark consisting of 868 catalog records and 104 expert-annotated queries with graded relevance judgments. We evaluate sparse (BM25), dense (sentence-transformers), hybrid, and LLM-assisted retrieval methods in this book-search setting. Multilingual embeddings outperform Greek-specific models, while hybrid retrieval performs best overall. A query-level analysis shows that BM25 excels at named-entity queries, while dense and hybrid methods improve natural-language, noisy, cross-lingual, and concept queries. Field-aware prompting has model-specific effects, while LLM TOC summarization improves TOC-only retrieval and LLM post-filtering improves early-stage retrieval at a high cost. Overall, CUP enables real-world evaluation of Greek retrieval across lexical, semantic, noisy, and cross-lingual queries.
2607.21274.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了CUP，一個希臘書籍檢索基準，包含868條目錄記錄和104條專家標註的查詢，並附有分級相關性判斷。<lb/>在這個書籍搜索環境中，我們評估了稀疏（BM25）、密集（句子轉換器）、混合和LLM輔助檢索方法。<lb/>多語言嵌入的表現優於希臘特定模型，而混合檢索的整體表現最佳。<lb/>查詢層級的分析顯示，BM25在命名實體查詢中表現出色，而密集和混合方法則改善了自然語言、雜訊、跨語言和概念查詢。<lb/>領域感知提示對模型具有特定影響，而LLM TOC摘要改善了僅基於TOC的檢索，LLM後過濾則在高成本下改善了早期檢索。<lb/>總體而言，CUP使得希臘檢索在詞彙、語義、雜訊和跨語言查詢方面的現實評估成為可能。
